title: Nothing organic is a flat-shaded ball: no faceted spheres under living tags
note: Nothing organic is a flat-shaded sphere, icosahedron or capsule — faceted balls read as rocks from every camera.
intent: A flat-shaded sphere or icosahedron reads as a rock, whatever it is tagged. Every time a build has stood a faceted ball in for something alive — a bush, a hay bale, a chicken, a puff of smoke, a head — the judge has named it as a blob. Replace the primitive with the shape family that actually reads: leaf cards for anything leafy, a small hierarchy of parts for an animal or a person, a soft additive sprite for smoke, a cylinder with cut ends for a log. If a sphere is genuinely right (a pumpkin, a ball), give it a smooth normal and a material rather than flatShading, so it stops reading as low-poly stone.

check.js: (() => { const organic = tags().filter(t => /tree|bush|canopy|crown|hedge|shrub|hay|straw|chicken|hen|dog|goat|sheep|cow|pig|horse|cat|bird|villager|npc|smoke/i.test(t)); let bad = 0; for (const tag of organic) for (const o of objects(tag)) o.traverse(m => { if (m.isMesh && /Sphere|Icosahedron|Dodecahedron|Octahedron|Tetrahedron|Capsule/.test(m.geometry?.type ?? '') && m.material?.flatShading === true) bad++; }); return bad === 0; })()
check.detail: (() => { const organic = tags().filter(t => /tree|bush|canopy|crown|hedge|shrub|hay|straw|chicken|hen|dog|goat|sheep|cow|pig|horse|cat|bird|villager|npc|smoke/i.test(t)); const hits = []; for (const tag of organic) for (const o of objects(tag)) o.traverse(m => { if (m.isMesh && /Sphere|Icosahedron|Dodecahedron|Octahedron|Tetrahedron|Capsule/.test(m.geometry?.type ?? '') && m.material?.flatShading === true) hits.push(tag + ':' + m.geometry.type); }); return 'flat-shaded sphere-like meshes under organic tags: ' + hits.length + (hits.length ? ' (' + hits.slice(0, 6).join(', ') + ')' : ''); })()
check.note: Nothing organic (trees, bushes, hay, animals, people, smoke) is a flat-shaded sphere/icosahedron/capsule. Faceted balls read as rocks; organic things are cards, parts, or smooth shapes with a material.

port: Anywhere the facet is tempted to reach for SphereGeometry or IcosahedronGeometry under a living tag, reach for a foliage helper, a parts group, or a modelled asset instead.
